scientific_integrity: Spherical-moment, spectral-extremum, and averaging arguments are given explicitly, with reproducible independent exact-arithmetic checks. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No complex coefficients, higher harmonic degrees, higher moments, general manifolds, scalar L4 extremum, or stronger metric-distance stability; finite symbolic tests supplement but do not constitute universal proofs. A semantically equivalent, currently unindexed gradient-norm theorem might exist.
scientific_scope: Real trace-zero symmetric quadratic harmonics on uniformly measured unit spheres in ambient dimensions n>=2; intrinsic gradient L4 norm, exact normalized gradient fourth-moment endpoints, spectral equality and real Euclidean Banach--Mazur distortion.
title: Exact Sobolev gradient fourth moments and Euclidean distortion of quadratic spherical harmonics
